sourceDocs: What Would Be My Ultimate Wishlist If I Could Control Cloudflare?
If Cloudflare Gave Me the Keys: What I'd Actually Build
purpose: Extend the existing six-journey Cloudflare creator-outcome campaign with specific production/application/media/game/agent/enterprise proof profiles. Profiles share its runner/report/evidence contract; they are not another benchmark engine, forced release gate, provider claim or automatic green result.
resultPolicy: Every profile is not-run until real version-pinned user/provider evidence exists. A blocked prerequisite is blocked, a missing observation is inconclusive. Never convert fixtures or local green checks into user outcome, cost, cloud, phone, media or residency proof. Existing six-required-journey denominator remains unchanged; profile denominator/status is reported separately. Fail closed on rights, secrets, cross-tenant writes, fabricated source identity or unapproved spend.

profiles.name: New creator to useful owned application
profiles.outcome: A person without existing Cloudflare/Wrangler knowledge creates a useful multi-resource app, reopens it, makes a second change and owns the result.
profiles.baseline: Record the same frozen task through the currently supported manual Get Ready/Init + ordinary Git/Cloudflare setup before comparing an improved provider-assisted path.
prerequisites: Consent from a real novice or explicitly label an agent-only exercise; fixed brief and selected references
Authorised disposable Cloudflare target or local-only evaluation marked blocked for provider steps
Predeclare resource graph, cost ceiling, permissions, recovery and cleanup owner
steps: Start from a clean creator state and measure real comprehension and time to first meaningful preview
Inspect proposed application graph, typed plan, resource reuse, costs and missing/unknown bindings
Produce the real running app and verify expected routes, content/form state, auth and save/reopen
Reopen as owner, request a useful second change, verify changed source and live identity
Export owned source/config/supported data with independent source-of-truth and unknowns disclosed
profiles.positiveControl: A permitted creator completes the configured app and verifies the real saved follow-up change.

negativeCases.scenario: Withhold a necessary declared binding
negativeCases.expected: Plan refuses/flags the gap; no fabricated complete graph

negativeCases.scenario: Change a disposable resource after plan approval
negativeCases.expected: Execution rechecks, refuses or reprices the changed target

negativeCases.scenario: No connected agent, account or permission
negativeCases.expected: Useful local/onboarding path remains available; provider operation stays blocked

evidence: Pinned brief, journey and accepted references
Starting account/agent capability inventory and proposed resource graph
Real preview/live state and output/source/version record
Novice observation, assist steps, cost report and source/data export
limits: Not live-qualified. Use actual authorised provider and independently observed user outcome for claims.
Record comparator and all attempted runs; do not silently drop failures, cost unknowns, no-provider, no-model or physical-device limits.

profiles.name: Phone-only supervised agent change to verified live release
profiles.product: App Composer mobile release desk · Guestbook/Linkarooie pilot
profiles.outcome: An authorised phone user supervises a real agent change, preview, review, guarded release and independent live verification while their laptop is unavailable.
profiles.baseline: Run the same bounded change with existing ordinary Git and local repository release commands; distinguish task runtime from supervisory time.
prerequisites: Explicitly selected source revision, disposable preview and authorized owner release path
Approved remote executor/agent integration; no assumption a browser/phone itself can host builds
Document runner sleep/offline behaviour, timeouts, approval policy, expected live source identity
steps: With local laptop unavailable, start from phone and read active repo, Worker version, work state and permissions
Delegate one small source change, observe real job identity/status/logs and exact diff
Start an isolated working preview; verify target identity and one real user interaction
Approve according to existing rules, pass independent review/guards and release only the approved SHA
Re-read live Worker identity, actual served origin and user journey, preserving failure/unknown status when identity differs
Disconnect/reopen phone between stages and reconcile in-flight status without duplicate effects
profiles.positiveControl: One real authorised change is verified live and remains operable after the phone disconnects.

negativeCases.scenario: Suspend disposable runner during a bounded long task
negativeCases.expected: State reports sleep/interruption accurately, not successful background execution

negativeCases.scenario: Preview or production reports a mismatched source/Worker revision
negativeCases.expected: Release/verification refuses success

negativeCases.scenario: Lose one provider acknowledgement after an operation
negativeCases.expected: Reconcile by durable ID before retrying; no duplicate effect

evidence: Mobile session journey and actual runner/service identity
Task/PR/review/release receipts and exact commits
Preview capture and independent production browser/result evidence
Interruption/reconciliation and measured time/cost ledger
limits: Not live-qualified. Use actual authorised provider and independently observed user outcome for claims.
Record comparator and all attempted runs; do not silently drop failures, cost unknowns, no-provider, no-model or physical-device limits.

profiles.name: Parallel agent alternatives with Git/Artifacts portability
profiles.product: App Composer workspace-provider adapter · optional Artifacts
profiles.outcome: Two independent agents create competing improvements from an identical immutable base, review the actual alternatives, retain all candidates and export the selected result to normal Git/GitHub.
profiles.baseline: Use conventional git branches/worktrees/bundles; compare friction only if a qualified Artifacts backend is available.
prerequisites: Pinned synthetic source fixture, two isolated workspaces and separate task permissions
GitHub remains authoritative for accepted source; Artifacts optional and version/capability checked
Cloudflare local simulator does not certify push-triggered cloud behaviour
steps: Fork/branch the pinned fixture into two independent task workspaces
Have two selected permitted agents make intentionally different changes and capture complete diff/review receipts
Test conflict/rebase and ensure neither branch changes the other or production
Export selected and unselected work as standard Git, restore in clean non-Artifacts checkout
Compare measured setup/export/cleanup time with ordinary Git; refuse unsupported local push-event parity claims
Revoke grants and clean up only owned workspaces while retaining accepted source and proof
profiles.positiveControl: Both alternatives and one accepted Git round trip are recoverable without Artifacts.

negativeCases.scenario: Attempt one task grant against the other task repository
negativeCases.expected: Denied with zero cross-task writes

negativeCases.scenario: Both tasks change the same tracked base
negativeCases.expected: Conflict is observable and handled; no silent overwrite

negativeCases.scenario: Expect remote push-triggered build from the local simulator
negativeCases.expected: Mark unsupported or separately qualify remote; no fake event

evidence: Base/candidate SHA and diff evidence
Per-task permissions and denied-operation receipts
Ordinary Git export and source-verified clean restore
Qualified backend/version, local-vs-remote limitations and comparison ledger
limits: Not live-qualified. Use actual authorised provider and independently observed user outcome for claims.
Record comparator and all attempted runs; do not silently drop failures, cost unknowns, no-provider, no-model or physical-device limits.

profiles.name: Original song to finished editable music video
profiles.outcome: A rights-cleared original song becomes a complete coherent music video with revision-linked scene plan, approved takes, audio sync, real render, saved originals and usable export.
profiles.baseline: Use Studio's existing supported production/assembly actions; any model/GPU runner qualification is a distinct optional comparison.
prerequisites: Owned/licensed song and visual references; source fingerprints, project version and rights
Declare expected duration, scene plan, output profile, provider eligibility, CPU/GPU and codec requirements
Set bounded processing allowance and supported human art review; no invented model entitlement
steps: Ingest original audio and preserve provenance, preference/reference approvals and editable plan
Prepare and revise scene directions; compare at least two legitimate creative alternatives when supported
Produce/choose actual takes and retained revisions; edit in/out points, captions and soundtrack alignment
Render complete playable output using an authorised supported engine; preserve inputs, hashes and failed attempts
Seek/play real video and sound, reopen/edit one shot and re-render; verify correct changed version
Have a person assess actual musical/story quality separately from valid-file and technical correctness
profiles.positiveControl: A finished version-pinned MP4 with corresponding editable project and approval can be reopened and revised.

negativeCases.scenario: Interrupt a bounded render, transfer or status response
negativeCases.expected: Durable job identity or honest unsupported resume; no fake finished film

negativeCases.scenario: Provide an intentionally wrong cut/caption/audio offset
negativeCases.expected: Detect mismatch rather than judging any decodable MP4 as successful

negativeCases.scenario: Use withdrawn/unapproved source media in public export
negativeCases.expected: Publication prevented, originals retained appropriately

evidence: Original song hash/rights and saved editable project
Shot/caption/audio timing map, take and version lineage
Playable final export plus browser/decoder observation
Creative review and real provider cost/cancellation receipts
limits: Not live-qualified. Use actual authorised provider and independently observed user outcome for claims.
Record comparator and all attempted runs; do not silently drop failures, cost unknowns, no-provider, no-model or physical-device limits.

profiles.name: Real game and music player experience on mobile
profiles.outcome: A real browser/player completes a meaningful first-five-minute game or start/navigate/seek audio task with actual canvas, sound and performance evidence tied to its source version.
profiles.baseline: Use each owning game's deterministic replay and Playwright/browser suite; do not replace native tests with a generic score.
prerequisites: Pin game build, save seed/replay and exact device/viewport/audio expectations
Explicitly distinguish Chromium emulation, WebKit and physical iOS testing; do not claim unavailable hardware coverage
Select a recording method that captures relevant canvas/WebGL pixels and audio if needed
steps: Start new or restored session and verify real playable/reachable menu controls
Perform a fixed interaction (combat move, bubble placement, catch or multiplayer turn) and inspect authoritative state
Record actual rendered pixels, audio continuity, frame-time distribution and error/network evidence
Restart/reopen to verify correct progress; check reduced motion, touch targets, keyboard where relevant
For LoftwahFM start, navigate and seek without unintended pause; verify real audible output
Have a human rate comprehension and enjoyment/usefulness separately from deterministic checks
profiles.positiveControl: Complete the required interaction with real state evidence, playable capture and source/build identity.

negativeCases.scenario: Give a DOM recording with omitted canvas/audio
negativeCases.expected: The omitted visual/audio parts remain unqualified

negativeCases.scenario: Attach a recording from an older build
negativeCases.expected: Reject as current release evidence

negativeCases.scenario: Damage a disposable save snapshot
negativeCases.expected: Report incompatibility or safe recovery; don't silently erase saved play

evidence: Gameplay/seek recording with actual pixels and audio
Game state/replay/save receipt, build/source hash
Frame sample count and trace plus browser vs device limitations
Attributed human judgement and linked project issue/release

profiles.name: Two-tenant governed operations, costs and region
profiles.product: App Composer · independent two-workspace enterprise fixture
profiles.outcome: Two distinct creator/tenant identities can use permitted apps and scoped agent actions, while cross-tenant access, unauthorised spending and unsupported residency claims are blocked.
profiles.baseline: Compare the same permission test to current Composer grants plus provider-side scoped tokens; don't assume Cloudflare account ownership equals app membership.
prerequisites: Create only owned disposable tenant/project fixtures; no real customer data
Declare role/resource/action matrix, lease durations, revocation and residency needs
Set independent spend/request ceilings and document advisory vs enforceable budgets
steps: Create two isolated project contexts with separate accounts/grants and named resource bindings
Verify valid read, preview and scoped write actions with the least privileged role
Attempt cross-tenant read/write and production permission escalation; verify provider boundary
Revoke one grant and observe subsequent/in-flight work within bounded attempts
Report observed per-project/provider costs, forecast assumptions and spend uncertainty separately
Evaluate Australian residency requirement against actual product/account configuration; if not available report blocker not compliance
profiles.positiveControl: Authorised operations work while prohibited cross-tenant effects do not occur.

negativeCases.scenario: Use tenant A grant for tenant B resource
negativeCases.expected: Deny, audit and verify no side effect

negativeCases.scenario: Propose a task above declared allowance
negativeCases.expected: Require approval or refuse; do not treat budget alerts as hard caps

negativeCases.scenario: Omit jurisdiction evidence for a region-sensitive project
negativeCases.expected: Do not assert data residency compliance

evidence: Signed-off role/action/tenant fixture and resource mapping
Permitted and denied operation traces with secrets redacted
Revocation/budget observations and provider bills where actually available
Actual region/jurisdiction facts, limitations and residual risk

profiles.name: App-wide incident investigation and independently verified recovery
profiles.outcome: An authorised operator diagnoses a controlled multi-resource regression, proposes proportionate repair and proves usable application recovery without losing protected state.
profiles.baseline: Use existing app-specific guarded release and D1/R2 export/restore scripts as comparator; no assumption a Worker rollback restores state.
prerequisites: Isolated deployment with preapproved fault injection, backups and independently testable restore
Resource dependency inventory including unread/unknown service settings
Recovery objective for code, D1 schema/records, R2 and grants kept separate
steps: Establish a working app and capture source/Worker/config/data/media baseline
Introduce one bounded fault on disposable resources; correlate real traces and user-visible failure
Identify likely cause and list unknown dependencies; present repair and impact plan
Apply an approved compatible correction or coordinated restore with distinct code/data/media steps
Reopen real user journey, compare retained records, deletion/privacy state and original/active versions
Record recovery elapsed time, missing observations, rollback limits and measured resource use
profiles.positiveControl: Useful app recovers in the isolated environment with protected source/data/media/rights state intact.

negativeCases.scenario: Restore Worker code while D1 schema or R2 state differs
negativeCases.expected: Do not claim full application recovery until checked

negativeCases.scenario: Hide one critical dependency
negativeCases.expected: Expose uncertainty; prevent destructive cleanup from incomplete graph

negativeCases.scenario: Restore older backup that contains withdrawn/deleted test media
negativeCases.expected: Tombstone/visibility policy remains enforced or test fails

evidence: Fault declaration and initial healthy user result
Actual source/config/deployment/data/media identities
Detection/hypothesis/recovery steps with independent recheck
Backup/restore readouts and explicit unsupported aspects

profiles.name: App Composer recursively rebuilds and evolves itself
profiles.product: App Composer · portable LEGO blueprints and second Cloudflare account
profiles.outcome: An independently owned App Composer installation can be constructed through Composer's documented method, reproduce supported modules and then use the new instance to create and evolve a real third app.
profiles.baseline: Compare with manually deploying the same pinned Composer release and equivalent dependency/secret-free fixture.
prerequisites: Exact source versions, reusable block manifests, compatibility and licence/rights checks
Isolated independent Cloudflare account/credentials explicitly authorised by that owner
Freeze functional parity assertions, exclusions and cost limits before any attempt
steps: Enumerate the actual canonical components, app manifests, source, content/media provenance and deployment dependencies
Export a versioned blueprint/recipe and install in a clean second account without original owner credentials
Verify deployed Composer identity, privacy, content models, reusable blocks and independent management
Use reconstructed Composer to create one new useful app; then perform a separate follow-up change
Attempt a documented repeat reconstruction from the new instance if supported; otherwise mark blocked, not self-rebuilt
Compare observed behaviour against the agreed parity matrix, with missing modules and manual interventions exposed
profiles.positiveControl: Second installation proves supported independent operation and a genuine create/change workflow.

negativeCases.expected: Importer refuses publication/transfer

Independent account deployment and auth/secret boundaries
Actual app/new-project user journeys and versioned proofs
Original vs rebuilt comparison, unsupported modules and retained alternatives

profiles.name: Evidence-led portfolio telemetry and actionable Cloudflare feedback
profiles.product: App Composer Benchmarks Studio/Share · Woodhouse public observatory
profiles.outcome: An operator sees which exact versions are live and which tasks actually completed across multiple independent projects, then publishes one rights-approved source-linked benchmark and one reproducible upstream improvement request.
profiles.baseline: Compare disconnected manual inspection of GitHub, Cloudflare and project-native release reports to the supported project-aware interface.
prerequisites: Select publicly safe test projects or authorised redacted projections
Define freshness and sample-count policy, user approval for any publication
Preserve GitHub, Cloudflare, Studio and portfolio project authorities separately
steps: Resolve at least two independent projects from source to active provider identity and actual origin checks
Join authorised work/issue/release/health facts without guessing unobserved dependencies
Display provenance, time/freshness, unknown cost and private/public scope
Retain a benchmark run with pinned inputs, measured limitations, human interpretation and negative case
Create an approved public derivative/shareable excluding private issues, prompts, media and credentials
Write one Cloudflare feedback report: observed provider limitation vs local app bug, workaround, measured cost and smallest falsifiable ask
profiles.positiveControl: A public-safe reviewed report links to actual observations and upstream feedback without exposing private project data.

negativeCases.expected: Publication denied or redacted with no leak
